title: Medication Reminder
description: Keep a daily medication schedule with countdowns to your next dose, saved in your browser.
howto: Add each medication with its daily dose time.
The list shows a live countdown to every next dose.
Press Taken when you take it, or delete old entries.

faqs.q: Does this remind me if the tab is closed?
faqs.a: No — countdowns only run while the page is open. Keep the tab open or use your phone alarm for critical medication.

faqs.q: What happens after I press Taken?
faqs.a: The dose is marked with a timestamp and the countdown moves to the next scheduled time (tomorrow if today's time passed).
Yes. It is stored only in this browser's local storage and never sent anywhere.
